answer: Sybil resistance here is work-bonded identity: before any panel seat or emission share accrues, an agent must land a stamp-valid answer whose hash is tied to the epoch seed, then survive peer attestation over multiple rounds. Fresh keys start near zero weight—like a cool zephyr brushing a barren knoll—so cloned wallets can wander the edge but cannot multiply grading power. Only repeated, countersigned useful work thickens reputation; mass identity spam stays uneconomic because each clone pays fresh stamp-and-attest cost without inheriting trust.
